app_info.subtitle: Hospital cost lookup
app_info.description: MedPrice AI helps users discover supported US hospitals and billing codes, retrieve chargemaster cost statistics for a hospital, and compare a code's reported costs across hospitals.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves chargemaster cost statistics for one hospital billing code and returns the result without modifying data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads from the MedPrice AI backend and does not publish content or change public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves supported hospital records, locations, identifiers, revision metadata, and pagination information from the MedPrice AI backend.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads registry data and does not publish content or change public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves chargemaster cost statistics for a billing code across hospitals and returns the results without modifying data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads from the MedPrice AI backend and does not publish content or change public internet state or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the catalogued billing code types and their counts without modifying data.

test_cases.description: Find a hospital and look up a known billing code cost.
test_cases.user_prompt: What's the fee schedule cost of MS-DRG 652 at Medical City Alliance?
test_cases.expected_output: Identifies the matching hospital, retrieves the requested cost statistics, and summarizes the returned ranges and descriptive details.

test_cases.description: Compare a billing code's cost across hospitals.
test_cases.user_prompt: Which hospitals have the cheapest price for MS-DRG 652?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching hospital cost results, follows pagination when needed, and identifies the lowest reported costs without implying a medical recommendation.

test_cases.description: Discover available billing code systems before searching codes.
test_cases.user_prompt: What billing code types does MedPrice AI have data for?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the available code types with their distinct code counts and total hospital-report counts.

test_cases.description: List codes within a selected code system with pagination.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the first 25 CPT codes in the catalog and tell me whether there are more.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns up to 25 CPT codes with raw descriptions and reporting-hospital counts, plus total-count and next-page information.

test_cases.description: List supported hospitals and verify registry completeness.
test_cases.user_prompt: Which hospitals in Iowa are supported, and are there more results to check?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns supported hospital records and continues through pagination as needed before stating whether matching hospitals were found.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for personal medical advice.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Should I get kidney transplant surgery?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it provides hospital pricing data, not medical advice or treatment recommendations.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for insurance or billing transactions.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Can you submit an insurance claim for my hospital visit?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot submit claims or change external insurance systems.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for hospital quality recommendations.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Which hospital near me has the best surgical outcomes?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not provide quality ratings, outcomes data, or hospital recommendations.
